questions.q: There is no time limit for stopping to pick up or drop off passengers.
This sign indicates that parking is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This is a supplementary sign indicating the 'end' of a restriction.

questions.q: The passenger capacity of a motorized bicycle is one person, but if there is a seat other than the driver's seat, the capacity is two people.
questions.explanation: Motorized bicycles are limited to one person only.

questions.q: Light vehicles are included in the category of automobiles.
questions.explanation: Light vehicles are considered 'vehicles' but not 'automobiles.'

questions.q: It is prohibited to stop or park within 5 meters before or after a pedestrian crossing or bicycle crossing lane.
When driving an automatic vehicle down a long slope, it is best to use only the foot brake.
questions.explanation: Use the engine brake and supplement with the foot brake.

questions.q: This sign indicates a merging intersection ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a Y-shaped road intersection ahead.

questions.q: When entering or exiting a tunnel, brightness changes suddenly, which may temporarily reduce visibility, so it is advisable to slow down.
When riding a two-wheeled vehicle, the helmet should be a standard size, strong, and heavy.
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that is not heavy.

questions.q: For four-wheeled vehicles, seat adjustment should allow the knees to be fully extended when pressing the brake or clutch pedal.
questions.explanation: The knees should be slightly bent when pressing the pedals.

questions.q: Unlike first-class or second-class licenses, a provisional license has no validity period.
questions.explanation: The validity period of a provisional license is six months.

questions.q: This sign indicates that the road ahead is under construction.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign indicating uneven road surfaces ahead.

questions.q: A large motorcycle is a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine displacement exceeding 250cc.
questions.explanation: A large motorcycle has an engine displacement exceeding 400cc.

questions.q: The license plate for commercial four-wheeled vehicles with a displacement of 660cc or less is black with yellow lettering.
In muddy or wet areas, care must be taken to avoid splashing water or mud on pedestrians by slowing down.
If no passengers are boarding or alighting from a stopped tram and a distance of at least 1.5 meters can be maintained, you may pass slowly without stopping.
This sign indicates a bicycle crossing lane.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a bicycle-only lane.

questions.q: On steep downhill slopes, vehicles must proceed slowly.
Motorized bicycles, light vehicles, and small special vehicles must travel in the leftmost lane unless turning right or due to road construction.
When an emergency vehicle approaches, there is no need to pull over to the left if traffic is light and the road is wide enough.
questions.explanation: Regardless of traffic or road width, vehicles must pull over to the left to yield.

questions.q: The legal speed limit for a motorcycle or motorized bicycle with a displacement of 125cc or less when towing another vehicle is 25 km/h.
This marking indicates a no-stopping zone, and vehicles or trams must not enter if they are likely to stop within it.
Overtaking is prohibited on steep downhill slopes, but it is allowed near the top of uphill slopes.
questions.explanation: Overtaking is also prohibited near the top of uphill slopes.

questions.q: When traffic is heavy and there is a risk of being unable to exit a priority bus lane, vehicles must not use that lane.
When driving on snowy roads, it is best to avoid the tracks made by other vehicles as much as possible.
questions.explanation: It is safer to drive in the tracks made by other vehicles.

questions.q: On roads without sidewalks or shoulders, automobiles (except motorcycles) cannot travel on the shoulder.
This sign indicates the type of vehicle, in this case, large trucks, specific medium trucks, or large special vehicles.
Vehicles may travel on tram tracks if it is clear that no trams are passing.
questions.explanation: Travel on tram tracks is allowed only with a 'tram track passage permitted' sign.

questions.q: This is a directional supplementary sign indicating the direction of the route, facility, or place specified by the main sign.
The area between the outer edge of the roadway and the sidewalk is considered part of the roadway.
When turning right from a one-way road, you must first move to the left side of the road and signal.
questions.explanation: You must move to the right side of the road when turning right.

questions.q: This sign indicates that animals may suddenly appear.
This marking indicates a bicycle crossing lane.
A flashing yellow signal allows vehicles to proceed slowly without stopping, while paying attention to other traffic.
questions.explanation: There is no obligation to stop or slow down at a flashing yellow signal.

questions.q: Overtaking is prohibited at railway crossings and within 30 meters before them.
The legal speed limit for ordinary trucks is 50 km/h.
questions.explanation: The legal speed limit for ordinary trucks is 60 km/h.

questions.q: This sign indicates that vehicles must not proceed in any direction other than the one indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the direction-specific lanes at an intersection.

questions.q: When stopping at a red light, vehicles are allowed to enter a no-stopping zone.
questions.explanation: Vehicles must avoid stopping in a no-stopping zone even at a red light.

questions.q: If mud or water splashes while passing through a muddy or wet area, the driver is not responsible if they were driving slowly.
questions.explanation: If splashing cannot be avoided by slowing down, the driver must stop temporarily.

questions.q: In case of a traffic violation or accident, the driver may face criminal, administrative, or civil liability.
Gross vehicle weight is the total weight of the vehicle, maximum load, and passenger capacity.
This sign is a guide sign indicating an emergency telephone on the highway.
If it is clear that no bicycles are crossing a bicycle crossing lane, overtaking is allowed in that lane.
questions.explanation: Overtaking is prohibited in bicycle crossing lanes regardless of bicycle presence.

questions.q: This sign indicates the maximum width, and vehicles exceeding the indicated width cannot pass.
A steep slope refers to a gradient of approximately 10% (6 degrees or more).
Minicars with a displacement of 50cc or less are included in the category of motorized bicycles.
questions.explanation: Minicars, even with 50cc or less, are considered regular automobiles.

questions.q: This marking indicates a prohibition on bicycles entering an intersection, and regular bicycles must not cross the marking into the intersection.
With permission from the police chief, vehicles can travel slowly on pedestrian-only roads while being cautious of pedestrians.
Vehicles must not travel on tram tracks, but they may do so if necessary to prevent danger.
The load width of a motorized bicycle may protrude up to 0.15 meters on either side of the loading device.
